title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks + metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Add per-prompt regression CI hooks and a lightweight metrics adapter to integrate eval-harness results with CI. Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from landing by running per-prompt quality checks as part of PR validation and provide a standardized metrics payload for downstream dashboards. This PR introduces: 1) a reusable GitHub Actions workflow (eval-harness/.github/workflows/prompt-regression.yml) that runs targeted per-prompt evals, 2) a new CI hook implementation (eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_hook.py) that loads prompt-sets and emits per-prompt pass/fail + confidence metrics, 3) a minimal metrics adapter (eval-harness/eval/metrics/ci_adapter.py) to serialize eval results in a CI-friendly JSON format, 4) tests and fixtures (eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt_hook.py, eval-harness/prompt_sets/default_prompts.yaml), and 5) docs with configuration and rollout guidance (eval-harness/docs/ci-integration.md). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4921) - [x] CI workflow created and smoke-tested - [x] Tests added for hook logic - [x] Metrics payload contract agreed with observability (ENG-5002) - [x] Backward compatibility for existing eval runners ensured

Compatibility notes: the new CI hook is opt-in via a repo-level labels/paths selector; it does not change existing nightly/eval flows. The metrics adapter emits a compact schema (version v1) so dashboards can start consuming immediately; any consumers should be resilient to extra fields. Troubleshooting: see docs/ci-integration.md for configuring timeouts and sample failure triage steps.
